note: Validation cases that do not meet their expected range. The regression test (crates/sim/tests/validate.rs) tolerates exactly these so that a new failure is caught; they stay failed evidence checks in every assessment. A case is reviewed only when `relevance` states what the deviation means for the intended comparisons, `followUp` names the repair or the limit on use, and `reviewed` is true. Reasons restate the notes of data/calibration/validation.md; none has been reviewed for the intended comparisons yet.

deviations.reason: Start-up lost time is 0.20 s against 1 to 3 s [FHWA-STM2008]: the simulator has no response delay at the onset of green (about 2 s short).
Two-way stop minor-right capacity at major 600 per direction is 364 veh/h against 378 to 631 [Brilon1999] (gap formula 505, critical gap 6.2 s, follow-up 3.3 s).
Two-way stop minor-right capacity at major 1000 per direction is 172 veh/h against 223 to 372 [Brilon1999] (gap formula 298).

Circle entry capacity at 600 circulating veh/h is 425 against 496 to 744 [Rodegerdts2007] (1130 exp(-0.001 vc) = 620). It was 482 before vehicles held at a full ring lane stopped being stored in the node (expose-junction-fallback-validity).

Circle entry capacity at 1000 circulating veh/h is 93 against 333 to 499 [Rodegerdts2007] (1130 exp(-0.001 vc) = 416). It was 164 before vehicles held at a full ring lane stopped being stored in the node (expose-junction-fallback-validity).
Signal lane with 300 cyclists/h sharing it keeps 0.64 of its capacity against a floor of 0.70; the range has source ASSUMPTION (no verified HCM bicycle factor, the floor is a guess).
All-way stop with 300 pedestrians/h on each crosswalk keeps 0.49 of its capacity against a floor of 0.60; the range has source ASSUMPTION.
All-way stop with 600 pedestrians/h on each crosswalk keeps 0.24 of its capacity against a floor of 0.60; the range has source ASSUMPTION.
All-way stop with 300 cyclists/h per approach keeps 0.56 of its capacity against a floor of 0.70; the range has source ASSUMPTION.

Signalized approach, 2 lanes, 10% left with a pocket against 500 opposing veh/h per lane: 777 veh/h per lane against 812 to 1071 [Brilon1999]. It passed at 848 while vehicles that could not enter their exit lane waited inside the node and more could follow them in; with that storage removed (expose-junction-fallback-validity) the approach discharges less.

Two-way stop minor through at major 1000 per direction: 76.5 veh/h against 45 to 76 [Brilon1999], 0.7 veh/h above the range. It was inside the range (72) before expose-junction-fallback-validity changed how vehicles held at a node exit enter their lane.

Gate-fed single-lane link at 25 mph carries 1,590 veh/h against 1,603 to 1,980 (0.85 to 1.05 of the drivers' mean equilibrium capacity) [Treiber2014]. It was 1,608 before arrivals were made to enter at the first step that starts at or after them (repair-local-trip-measurement-integrity); the 35 mph case g2 rose from 1,890 to 1,896 with the same change, so the shift is within one seed's variation.
